ko: 내 죄를 정케 하신 주 날 오라 하신다
en: I hear Thy welcome voice That calls me, Lord, to Thee For cleansing in Thy precious blood That flowed on Calvary
I am coming, Lord; Coming now to Thee Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood That flowed on Calvary

ko: 힘 주시고 내 추함을 곧 씻어주시네
en: Though I come weak and eile, Thou dost my strngth assure; Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse, Till spotless all and pure.
I am coming, Lord; Coming now to Thee Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood That flowed on Calvary

ko: 또 사랑함과 평안함 다 얻게 함일세
en: 'Tis Jesus calls me on To perfect faith and love, To perfect hope, and peace, and trust, For earth and heav'n abobe.
I am coming, Lord; Coming now to Thee Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood That flowed on Calvary

ko: 큰 죄인 복 받아 빌 길을 얻었네
한 없이 넓고 큰 은혜 베풀어 주소서
en: 'Tis Jesus who confirms The blessed work within By adding grece to welcomed grace, Where reigned the power of sin
I am coming, Lord; Coming now to Thee Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood That flowed on Calvary

ko: 내 기도 소리 들으사 다 허락하소서
en: His blood the witness gives Within my heart for me O, Savior, heed my every prayer, My full abundance be
I am coming, Lord; Coming now to Thee Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood That flowed on Calvary
